items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24
items.q: And, uh, this is Joyce and my granddaughter. ... This is Phillip and Joyce bought this.

ctx.x: You can get what things are.

Yes, indeed. So now that's this. Now what's all this? Oh, this is me sitting out here with the little boys, the little pages. Now, this is one I want you to see. Have you ever seen so many girls together at one time? You know, that's a good picture of being so many taken in one. Don't you think so? It really is. Now that's taken at the, at the Birgos Quay. These were the, the, um, the, um, uh, maids. What's the matter? These were the, um, the, um, I call them the girls in waiting at the, they were seating the…
Now they were made in the garden, the Creole Fest.
